name: Will of the Daeva (Akashic)
body:
You can use akasha to boost your willpower, giving you newfound strength of purpose.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13 or veilweaver level 1

Benefit(s): You can invest essence into this feat. You gain an insight bonus on Will saves equal to the invested essence.

You gain 1 point of essence.
